title: csszyx check --json, version 2
description: The document `csszyx check --json` writes to stdout: one finding per problem, each at the level the project gives it.

version.description: Bumped when a consumer would have to change to keep reading the document.

rule.description: The pass that produced the finding, as `--rule` and `rules` name it.

kind.description: What was found. For `sz-diagnostic` it is the diagnostic id, such as `unknown-key`; for every other pass it repeats the rule, or names a run-level problem of the pass.

message.description: The main sentence, with no header, label or line break.

help.description: What to do: the clause a terminal prints after `help:`. Absent when the finding has none.

note.description: What happened to the output: the clause a terminal prints after `note:`. Absent when the finding has none.

suggestion.description: For `unknown-key`, the known key it most likely misspells; the same value as `args.suggestion`.

args.description: For an `sz-diagnostic` finding, the values its sentence names, by name. The page at `url` lists them.

url.description: The page that explains the kind.

level.description: How loudly the project reports it. The run fails on `error`, or on what `--fail-on` names.
